description: Sri Lanka Customs - Rates of Exchange with effect from 22.05.2023 to 28.05.2023
reasoning: This gazette notification is issued under the Customs Ordinance (Chapter 235) and specifically deals with setting new rates of exchange for customs duties and other charges. It contains regulatory content about how customs calculations should be performed, making it a legal/regulatory matter rather than a government personnel or structural change. The mention of the Director General of Customs is incidental to the regulatory function being performed.
